data.case_title: Witness summons from Amtsgericht Musterdal (4 C 211/26)
data.explanation: The local court (Amtsgericht) in Musterdal summons you to testify as a witness in a civil lawsuit between a car buyer and a dealership, about a sales conversation you took part in. Go to the hearing on time, and bring this letter and a photo ID. If you cannot attend, you must excuse yourself to the court in advance with a valid reason; otherwise the court can make you pay the costs this causes and can impose a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under § 380 ZPO. You can claim compensation for travel costs and lost earnings under the JVEG. If attending is a problem, contact the court using the phone number on the letter.

items.title: Court hearing as a witness (Zeugin)
items.action: Attend the hearing in person at the stated time and place, bringing this summons letter and a photo ID.
items.consequence: If you fail to appear without sufficient excuse, you will have to bear the costs this causes and the court may impose a fine (Ordnungsgeld) against you.

key_facts.label: Subject of testimony
key_facts.quote: Sie sollen zu dem Verkaufsgespräch am 04.06.2026 aussagen, an dem Sie teilgenommen haben.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for sanctions on non-appearance
key_facts.quote: Wenn Sie ohne genügende Entschuldigung nicht erscheinen, werden Ihnen die dadurch verursachten Kosten auferlegt, und gegen Sie kann ein Ordnungsgeld festgesetzt werden (§ 380 ZPO).

data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterdal summons the recipient as a witness in the civil case Henning Krause vs. Beispiel Autohaus Altmark GmbH, to appear on 25 March 2027 at 10:30 to testify about a car sales conversation on 4 June 2026.
